quotes.text: Rented the Island Cruiser out of MDR for a bday party and everything was fabulous. We booked a 6-9pm cruise in July, so we went out in the ocean for an hour and saw so many dolphins, then cruised around the marina to catch sunset and let loose. The boat itself was huge with a chill spot up front, plenty of room to dance and sing karaoke. If you're looking for a boat, stop looking, book this one!

We did a corporate team-building event on the 63ft yacht and it was phenomenal. The space is surprisingly large with multiple areas - top deck for sunning, dance floor for activities, and a nice interior for presentations. Captain Tino and Ms. Sandy were fantastic!

Amazing boat and amazing people! Ryan and the crew were incredible hosts. We had 12 people for a bachelor party and everyone had a blast. The dance floor and karaoke were a hit. The captain took us along the coast and we even spotted dolphins. Highly recommend!

Booked the 59ft for my bachelorette party. The girls had so much fun with karaoke and dancing on the huge party deck. The sunset views from the boat were breathtaking. Ryan and January were super responsive and helpful with planning. Will definitely be back!

Best boat rental experience ever! We celebrated my 30th birthday and it was absolutely perfect. Great communicators, very responsive, and made all 12 of us feel safe and comfortable. The huge deck is perfect for parties. Don't hesitate to book!
